---
title: "Timeline"
subtitle: "Key dates in the life of Nelson Mandela"
toc: false
---

| Year | Event |
|------|-------|
| 1918 | Born on 18 July in Mvezo, Transkei, South Africa. |
| 1943 | Joins the African National Congress (ANC). |
| 1944 | Co-founds the ANC Youth League. |
| 1952 | Leads the Defiance Campaign; opens Mandela & Tambo law firm. |
| 1956 | Arrested and charged in the Treason Trial (acquitted in 1961). |
| 1960 | Sharpeville Massacre; the ANC is banned. |
| 1961 | Co-founds Umkhonto we Sizwe, the ANC's armed wing. |
| 1962 | Arrested and sentenced to five years' imprisonment. |
| 1964 | Sentenced to life imprisonment at the Rivonia Trial. |
| 1964–1982 | Imprisoned on Robben Island. |
| 1982–1988 | Held at Pollsmoor Prison. |
| 1988–1990 | Held at Victor Verster Prison. |
| 1990 | Released from prison on 11 February. |
| 1991 | Elected President of the ANC. |
| 1993 | Awarded the Nobel Peace Prize with F. W. de Klerk. |
| 1994 | Elected South Africa's first Black president on 27 April. |
| 1995 | South Africa hosts and wins the Rugby World Cup. |
| 1996 | New South African constitution adopted. |
| 1999 | Steps down as president; succeeded by Thabo Mbeki. |
| 2009 | UN declares 18 July "Nelson Mandela International Day." |
| 2013 | Dies on 5 December in Johannesburg, aged 95. |
